scope: Independent bounded review of exactly IDEA000015, IDEA000019, IDEA000020 and IDEA000021. Compact records and proposal designs were inspected programmatically; only GDT575 and GDT577 primary reports were opened. No registry review, build, corpus, image or experiment was performed.

records.title: A material whole recurs with one independently named part
records.assessment: Not nominated: its concentration statistic is a reasonable structural association screen, but the proposed independent part binding and five-folio panel are not present in the compact record; section-driven co-occurrence remains a direct rival.

records.title: A modifier whole scopes over the next head only
records.assessment: Nominate for method review: unlike a gloss claim, this is a falsifiable ordered-attachment contrast (next head versus prior head versus whole-field) and can change the structural parser choice.

records.title: A record-initial whole points to the visible source
records.assessment: Not nominated: native-owner evidence is a concrete requirement, but source pointing, positional opening, and proximity/section ownership remain confounded until the owner mapping is independently frozen.

records.title: A unit whole recurs across amounts without naming material
records.assessment: Not nominated: cross-material recurrence is an interpretable contrast, but the required material identities and unit slots are precisely the semantic bindings the proposal has not yet supplied.

nomination.question: Among the already structured relation/modifier slots, does a candidate modifier attach to the immediately following head more often than to the preceding head or whole field on held interrupted sequences?

source_start.quote: The 62 interrupted same-root groups also stay open. Almost every repeated grade is separated by an action, so its useful reading is likely local action–modifier attachment (`… auf Grad I … auf Grad I`) or a repeat particle, not a detached global count.

nomination.why_this_is_less_shared_by_rivals: The ordered next/prior/whole-field alternatives make a concrete structural prediction about attachment direction. A generic count, opener, or material model does not by itself predict that direction. The source reports already expose the rival topologies, while explicitly labeling the O/D_ADDR assignments exploratory, so this is a method-review starting point rather than semantic confirmation.
nomination.decision_consequence: A held, independently coded next-head excess would support a local forward attachment rule in the structural parser; a prior-head/whole-field result or stable mixed topology would reject the one-head rule while retaining the observed slot order.
required_review_repairs: Freeze modifier/head unit and held interrupted sequences before scoring.
Treat GDT577's 21/14/14/1 O/D_ADDR assignments as exploratory, not gold.
Keep the distinct five topology classes and test next-head, prior-head and whole-field alternatives without converting structural success into meaning.

limitations: The nomination is a structural method-review priority only. It does not establish a modifier meaning, a Voynich lexeme, or independent semantic gold; the other three designs remain unreviewed beyond this bounded screen.
